comment: SIMULATED adversarial cases for tools/scan/simulate.py. Every document generated from this fixture is fake attack surface used to test that the kb-scan workflow defends itself. Nothing here is a real CVE, MAL- id, branch move or verdict. All generated findings carry status:'unverified' and a SIMULATED marker. Never point the real pipeline at real feeds with these.
